Secretary of State, Elections Division 6 Town Hall Drive Princeton, MA 01541 978-464-2103 (phone) TOWN OF PRINCETON 978-464-2106 (fax) townclerk@town.princeton.ma.us MASSACHUSETTS Office of the Town Clerk NOTICE OF PUBLIC AUDIT (ELECTION RESULTS – PRECINCT 1) Section 109A of Chapter 54 of the General Laws requires random post-election audits to be conducted after presidential elections. Under this law, 3 per cent of all precincts in Massachusetts must be hand-counted. The selection is done by random, publicly verifiable, non-computerized drawing supervised by the Secretary within 48 hours of the close of polls. The law provides for a hand-count of only certain specified races, where more than one candidate is printed on the ballot, and a statewide ballot question, which is also randomly selected. On Thursday, November 7, 2024, Precinct 1 of the Town of Princeton, was one of 3 per cent of all precincts in Massachusetts selected for the post-election audit of results for the November 5, 2024 State Election. Pursuant to Section 109A of General Laws Chapter 54, G.L. c. 54 § 109A(d)(1) and 950 CMR § 46.01(1), the audit will be conducted on: Monday, November 11, 2024 at 9:00AM Location: Town Hall Annex, located at 4 Town Hall Drive, Princeton, MA 01541. The administration of the audit is conducted by the Registrars of Voters. The Board of Registrars can designate the local election official to perform the audit. If the clerk is designated to perform the audit, the registrars do not need to be present. Members of the public who wish to attend this audit are asked to contact townclerk@town.princeton.ma.us.
